name: symphony
description: Native C++26 MCP and Unix-socket IPC bridge, VGAA architectural rules, and operational skills for inspecting and administering a configured QuanuX Symphony installation through qxctl in Antigravity and Antigravity CLI.
suggestedPrompts: Use Symphony to inspect the connected installation, verify the pinned qxctl and registry digests, and summarize the available command families.
Use Symphony to run a read-only qxctl status or knowledge invariant command and explain the returned evidence without mutating state.
Prepare a Symphony non-read operation preview, review its exact argv, direct-file SHA-256 pins, authority mode, and recovery command, and wait for approval before apply.

connection_profile.title: Symphony connection profile
connection_profile.description: Absolute path to an operator-created mode-0600 connection.json file pinning the local qxctl executable SHA-256 and command-registry digest.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and administer a configured QuanuX Symphony installation via MCP and local Unix-socket IPC
interface.longDescription: Connects Antigravity, Antigravity CLI (agy), and MCP-compatible agents to an explicitly configured QuanuX Symphony installation through qxctl's machine-readable command registry. Provides 698 individually exposed public MCP tools (or 6 live-registry discovery tools), direct stdio and same-user Unix-socket IPC transports, digest-pinned execution, and single-use session-bound previews before non-read operations.
defaultPrompt: Use Symphony to inspect the connected installation and summarize its available command families.
Use Symphony to explain a qxctl command contract before running any read-only inspection.
Prepare a Symphony operation preview and show its authority and recovery details without applying it.
